_comment: Schema for data/pulse-quality-report.json — the Phase 2 quality gate report. It is assembled by the runner's --gate step and combines THREE independent layers: (1) the deterministic reconciler (scripts/lib/verify-claims.js — numbers, polarity, narrative, advice scan, freshness; pure code, no AI); (2) the independent AI validation agent (role 'validation', a DIFFERENT provider than editorial, e.g. gemini_3_1_pro) graded on grade/cohesion/honesty; (3) schema + the existing test suites. The final verdict is computed deterministically: RED if any hard check fails or confidence < min_confidence_for_yellow; YELLOW if confidence in [yellow,green) or a soft reconciler warning; GREEN only if everything is clean AND confidence >= green_threshold. Nothing auto-publishes unless verdict == GREEN AND auto_publish_enabled AND kill-switch on.

reconciler._comment: Deterministic checks from verify-claims.js. pass=true means no hard reconciliation failure. Pure code; never an AI judgement.

numbers_ok._comment: every prose number reconciles to real data or the allowlist

polarity_ok._comment: every drafted status word agrees with computed data direction via editorial_polarity

narrative_ok._comment: Weekly Connection narrative direction does not contradict aggregate signal directions

freshness_ok._comment: editorial dates are today and recompute leaves review_required false for edited items

validation_agent._comment: Independent AI checker (different provider than the drafter). It scores meaning-level quality the deterministic layer cannot. Its confidence feeds the verdict but can NEVER override a reconciler hard failure (a RED stays RED no matter how confident the validator is).

confidence._comment: overall confidence the draft is accurate, clear, and honest

reading_grade._comment: estimated US grade level of the drafted prose

honest_no_overclaim._comment: draft does not claim more than the findings + data support

narrative_reversal_acknowledged._comment: true if the judge reviewed and cleared any supported narrative reversal (or there was none). Optional; absent is treated as true.

validation_panel._comment: Phase 3 3-model adversarial panel. The gate uses panelMinConf = min(judge.confidence) as the verdict confidence, requires ALL judges' confidence >= publish bar (all_clear_publish) to auto-publish, and treats any judge hard issue (disclaimer not respected, overclaim, unsupported causal claim, or an unacknowledged supported reversal) as a block. validation_agent above is populated from the WORST/representative judge for backward compat.

min_confidence._comment: worst-case confidence across judges; this is what the verdict uses

all_clear_publish._comment: true iff EVERY judge confidence >= publish bar

no_advice._comment: Deterministic phrase-level advice/prediction backstop (scripts/lib/no-advice-scan.js) over the APPLIED tree's editable prose. pass=false (any hit) is a HARD block folded into the verdict.

narrative_consistency._comment: Deterministic narrative-reversal check (scripts/lib/narrative-consistency.js) comparing the previous live page to the applied draft. An UNSUPPORTED reversal (prose flips, data direction did not) is a HARD block. A SUPPORTED reversal is a soft_warning the panel must explicitly acknowledge (narrative_reversal_acknowledged) before a GREEN can publish.

structural._comment: Schema + test-suite + diff-guard results on the post-apply tree (computed deterministically).

editorial_only_diff._comment: true = applying the draft moved ONLY editable prose paths; false = a read-only data path would change (hard RED)

tests_pass._comment: all 5 existing scripts/test/* suites + data-validate recompute pass on the applied tree

clarity._comment: Deterministic whole-page clarity + jargon scan (scripts/lib/clarity-scan.js) over the APPLIED tree's editable prose. Pure code: scans every editable prose string on the page (not just triggered signals) for unexplained economic jargon and a Flesch-Kincaid reading grade. jargon_clean && grade_ok are HARD checks folded into the verdict; an unexplained jargon term or a page grade above the max anywhere hard-blocks publish. readonly_jargon is informational only.

jargon_clean._comment: no unexplained jargon in any gated (editable) prose string

publish_confidence._comment: separate, higher bar required to AUTO-PUBLISH (default 0.95); GREEN below this bar holds silently

blocking_reasons._comment: Human-readable list of every reason the verdict is not GREEN. Empty on GREEN.

auto_publish._comment: What the gate decided to DO. published is true ONLY when verdict GREEN AND confidence >= publish_bar AND clarity_clean AND auto_publish_enabled AND kill-switch on AND not shadow_mode AND not paused. A GREEN verdict below the publish bar (or with paused auto-publish) yields action 'held_below_bar' with a hold_reason and publishes NOTHING (holds silently, retries next cycle).

paused._comment: pause_auto_publish kill-switch is set; forces hold/review without disarming the pipeline

panel_min_confidence._comment: worst-case confidence across the panel (the verdict confidence)
